narrative.intro: Thalle Construction obligated $1.9B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Thalle Construction won 3 awards so far, with an average award size of $639M, and obligations are up 571.4% year over year. Thalle Construction receives virtually all FY2026 obligations from the Department of Defense, which obligated $1.9B. Thalle Construction’s work in FY2026 is concentrated in Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction, which accounts for $1.9B in obligations, while the Department of the Interior and Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction each appear at much smaller values of $114K. Historical obligations show that Thalle Construction’s federal receipts moved from $167M in FY21 and $213M in FY22, down to $16.1M in FY23, then up to $366M in FY24 and $285M in FY25, before reaching the current FY2026 total of $1.9B. The current-year totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date activity.

sections.heading: What explains Thalle Construction’s FY2026 obligations?
sections.body: Thalle Construction obligated $1.9B in FY2026 to date, driven by 3 large awards with an average award size of $639M. Thalle Construction’s obligations are up 571.4% year over year, reflecting a sharp increase from prior fiscal years. Thalle Construction’s FY2026 obligations sit almost entirely in Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction, which totals $1.9B.

sections.heading: Where do Thalle Construction’s contracts go?
sections.body: The Department of Defense obligated $1.9B to Thalle Construction in FY2026 to date. The Department of the Interior obligated $114K, and Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction shows $114K in market obligations as well.

faq.q: How much does Thalle Construction make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Thalle Construction has obligated $1.9B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Thalle Construction won 3 awards this fiscal year with an average award size of $639M, and obligations are up 571.4% year over year compared with prior periods.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Thalle Construction?
faq.a: The Department of Defense buys most of Thalle Construction’s federal work, obligating $1.9B in FY2026 to date. The Department of the Interior is a much smaller buyer, with obligations of $114K in the same period.

faq.q: What does Thalle Construction sell to the government?
faq.a: Thalle Construction sells heavy and civil engineering construction services to the government: Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction is the primary market at $1.9B. Thalle Construction also has activity in Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction, shown at $114K.
